newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens pulls plug on home electronics.
newsitem.headline: Siemens pulls plug on home electronics.

text.p: German giant Siemens AG said on Thursday it would pull the plug on its consumer electronics business because it has been producing unsatisfactory results.
The 80 employees in its Siemens Electronics unit would move over to Bosch-Siemens Hausgeraete GmbH, a joint venture with Robert Bosch GmbH that makes household appliances, the company said.
The move is the latest in a series of steps Siemens has taken to rev up earnings after a November warning that profits would not increase in the 1996/97 business year.
Earlier on Thursday, a member of Siemens supervisory board told Reuters the company was talking to Westinghouse Electric Corp. about combining fossil-fuel power operations.
